an8.34:1.1: Aṭṭhaṅgasamannāgate bhikkhave khette bījaṃ vuttaṃ na mahapphalaṃ hoti na mahassādaṃ na phātiseyyaṃ. Kathaṃ aṭṭhaṅgasamannāgate? Idha bhikkhave khettaṃ unnāmininnāmi ca hoti, pāsāṇasakkharillañ ca hoti, ūsarañ ca hoti, na ca gambhīrasitaṃ hoti, na āyasampannaṃ hoti, na apāyasampannaṃ hoti, na mātikāsampannaṃ hoti, na mariyādasampannaṃ hoti. Evaṃ aṭṭhaṅgasamannāgate bhikkhave khette bījaṃ vuttaṃ na mahapphalaṃ hoti na mahassādaṃ na phātiseyyaṃ.
an8.34:2.1: Evam eva kho bhikkhave aṭṭhaṅgasamannāgatesu samaṇabrāhmaṇesu dānaṃ dinnaṃ na mahapphalaṃ hoti na mahānisaṃsaṃ na mahājutikaṃ na mahāvipphāraṃ. Kathaṃ aṭṭhaṅgasamannāgatesu? Idha bhikkhave samaṇabrāhmaṇā micchādiṭṭhikā honti micchāsaṅkappā micchāvācā micchākammantā micchā-ājīvā micchāvāyāmā micchāsatino micchāsamādhino. Evaṃ aṭṭhaṅgasamannāgatesu bhikkhave samaṇabrāhmaṇesu dānaṃ dinnaṃ na mahapphalaṃ hoti na mahānisaṃsaṃ na mahājutikaṃ na mahāvipphāraṃ.
an8.34:3.1: Aṭṭhaṅgasamannāgate bhikkhave khette bījaṃ vuttaṃ mahapphalaṃ hoti mahassādaṃ phātiseyyaṃ. Kathaṃ aṭṭhaṅgasamannāgate? Idha bhikkhave khettaṃ anunnāmininnāmi ca hoti, apāsāṇasakkharillañ ca hoti, anūsarañ ca hoti, gambhīrasitaṃ hoti, āyasampannaṃ hoti, apāyasampannaṃ hoti, mātikāsampannaṃ hoti, mariyādasampannaṃ hoti. Evaṃ aṭṭhaṅgasamannāgate bhikkhave khette bījaṃ vuttaṃ mahapphalaṃ hoti mahassādaṃ phātiseyyaṃ.
an8.34:4.1: Evaṃ eva kho bhikkhave aṭṭhaṅgasamannāgatesu samaṇabrāhmaṇesu dānaṃ dinnaṃ mahapphalaṃ hoti mahānisaṃsaṃ mahājutikaṃ mahāvipphāraṃ. Kathaṃ aṭṭhaṅgasamannāgatesu? Idha bhikkhave samaṇabrāhmaṇā sammādiṭṭhikā honti sammāsaṅkappā sammāvācā sammākammantā sammā-ājīvā sammāvāyāmā sammāsatino sammāsamādhino. Evaṃ aṭṭhaṅgasamannāgatesu bhikkhave samaṇabrāhmaṇesu dānaṃ dinnaṃ mahapphalaṃ hoti mahānisaṃsaṃ mahājutikaṃ mahāvipphāran ti.
an8.34:5.1: Yathā pi khette sampanne pavuttā bījasampadā deve sampādayantamhi hoti dhaññassa sampadā.
an8.34:6.1: Anīti sampadā hoti virūḷhi bhavati sampadā vepullaṃ sampadā hoti phalaṃ ve hoti sampadā.
an8.34:7.1: Evaṃ sampannasīlesu dinnā bhojanasampadā sampadānaṃ upaneti sampannaṃ hi 'ssa taṃ kataṃ.
an8.34:8.1: Tasmā sampadam ākaṅkhī sampannattho 'dha puggalo sampannapaññe sevetha, evaṃ ijjhanti sampadā.
an8.34:9.1: Vijjācaraṇasampanno laddhā cittassa sampadaṃ karoti kammasampadaṃ labhati c' atthasampadaṃ.
an8.34:10.1: Lokaṃ ñatvā yathābhūtaṃ pappuyya diṭṭhisampadaṃ maggasampadam āgamma yāti sampannamānaso.
an8.34:11.1: Odhunitvā malaṃ sabbaṃ patvā nibbānasampadaṃ muccati sabbadukkhehi, sā hoti sabbasampadā ti.
